M-PORTAL-SOURCE.Summary: Editable AICC portal source: design tokens, copied O! UI kit and brand assets, per-field page content, interface messages, templates, and the build and check tools.

M-PORTAL-PROJECTION.Summary: Generated static site under html/aicc with Russian (primary) and English paths and shared assets. Never edited by hand.

M-AICC-DEPLOY.Summary: Rust command-line tool that checks the generated site, mirrors html/aicc into the clean deploy repository, writes a hashed manifest, and with an explicit flag commits, pushes origin then websvc, and verifies the served manifest. Dry run by default.
